entries.title: File:Water Bottle Donation to LVMPD.jpg

metadata.ImageDescription: The night after the October 1st mass shooting in Las Vegas, scouts from Las Vegas Area Council's Boyscouts Troop 430 gathered bottled water and food to donate to officers of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department. Officers were working extended shifts and needed snacks and water to keep them going. On October 3rd, A truck and trailer load of non-perishables was dropped off at LVMPD Northwest Area Command.
